fact: POTRAZ held a National Consultative Workshop in Nyanga with delegates on Data Protection Implementation Guidelines and the Draft Cyber and Data Protection Administrative Penalties (Amendment), covering proposed amendments to administrative fines.
title: The National Consultative Workshop on Data Protection Implementation Guidelines and the Draft Cyber and Data Protection Administrative Penalties (Amendment) concluded on a high note in Nyanga
publisher: Postal & Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)
